component.name: Gost
component.summary: Academic essay templater for LaTeX and Typst

description.p: Gost generates fully formatted LaTeX and Typst templates for academic essays and book manuscripts. Choose a citation style (SBL, Chicago, MLA, APA, ASA, Turabian, or Harvard), set your margins, font, and spacing, then export a ready-to-compile document.

Features include live compiled preview, Word (.docx) export, book publishing layout (bleed, crop marks, openright chapters, running headers), journal template importer, grammar check via LanguageTool, and template profiles.

screenshot.caption: Main window showing citation style selector and layout options

description.p: Development build: flatpak packaging, statusbar, and comprehensive book publishing features.
